classes.name: Enterprise suite CCaaS
classes.job: Run the contact center as the primary service interaction platform.
classes.definition: Primary CCaaS control plane with broad enterprise routing, digital, admin and operational depth.
classes.boundary: Compare breadth, operability and enterprise control relative to enterprise peers.

bestWhen.statement: Best when the buyer values a staged path from Cisco on-prem/enterprise contact center to cloud while preserving telephony and operational continuity.
The buyer runs meaningful outbound/proactive engagement alongside inbound service and values a mature dialer/proactive-engagement operating model.
The buyer wants a broad enterprise CCaaS control plane spanning routing, digital, WEM, analytics, AI and integrations, and has the operating maturity to own it.
The buyer needs broad native routing, workforce/quality, analytics, security/sovereignty and AI capabilities and has the operating capacity to use them.

classes.name: Composable and developer-led CCaaS
classes.job: Buyer builds and owns the contact center on cloud primitives, APIs and integration platforms.
classes.definition: Buyer builds and owns the contact center on cloud primitives, APIs and integration platforms.
classes.boundary: Judge build burden and operating ownership as fit variables, not automatic weaknesses.
classes.excluded: Turnkey suite assumptions are not universal requirements.

bestWhen.statement: The buyer wants native WFM/QM/analytics/workspace/AI plus deep APIs, IaC and AWS integration.
The buyer prioritizes availability, compliance, sovereign/private-cloud design and operational continuity over commodity-style procurement simplicity.

classes.name: UC-attached CCaaS
classes.job: Contact center added to a UCaaS phone system the buyer already runs.
classes.definition: Contact center added to a UCaaS phone system the buyer already runs.
classes.boundary: Do not penalize for narrower extreme-enterprise depth when not applicable.
classes.excluded: Extreme enterprise transformation requirements may be conditional.

bestWhen.statement: Use 8x8 when the buyer materially values one supplier family for UC+CC, global voice and CX operations rather than assembling multiple control planes.
Use Dialpad when the buyer values unified communications + contact center, native real-time AI, comparatively accessible administration and fast deployment more than extreme topology customizability.
RingCX is strongest when the buyer values a unified UC+CC operating model, packaged omnichannel and simple deployment more than maximum bespoke enterprise control-plane depth.
VCC is especially rational when Salesforce is the operating system for customer service and the buyer wants deep voice/digital routing plus CRM data in one workflow.
Best when Zoom Workplace/Phone is already strategic and the buyer wants CCaaS, digital, WFM/QM and AI with comparatively low platform sprawl.

classes.name: Regional and sovereignty-led CCaaS
classes.job: Meet geography, sovereignty and sector-specific operating requirements.
classes.definition: Primary CCaaS control plane with regional, data-sovereignty or regulated-market specialization.
classes.boundary: Compare within geography/sovereignty scope before global peer challenge.
classes.excluded: Global breadth is conditional to buyer requirements.

bestWhen.statement: Best when European hosting, French sovereign-cloud option and GDPR-aligned operating control materially affect the shortlist.
Use Puzzel when European data sovereignty, local/regional delivery, practical omnichannel CCaaS and modular expansion into WFM/QM/AI matter more than a global hyperscale footprint.

classes.name: Migration-centric CCaaS
classes.job: Reduce migration risk from incumbent/legacy environments.
classes.definition: Leave on-premises or legacy platforms without a big-bang cutover.
classes.boundary: Migration utility must not be conflated with future-state breadth.
classes.excluded: Greenfield innovation is a separate comparison.

bestWhen.statement: Best when the buyer has meaningful Aspect/Noble/Alvaria estate value to preserve while modernizing cloud/WEM/outbound operations.
Avaya Infinity is most differentiated when the buyer wants to modernize an Aura / Call Center Elite estate without forcing a single-step rip-and-replace migration.

Enghouse is especially rational when the buyer wants to preserve selected on-prem/private-cloud contact-center investments while adding modern cloud/AI capabilities and migrating on a controlled timetable.

classes.name: Teams-native CCaaS
classes.job: Contact center built on Microsoft Teams as the agent and telephony surface.
classes.definition: Contact center built on Microsoft Teams as the agent and telephony surface.

bestWhen.statement: Teams/Azure/Microsoft 365 are strategic and the buyer wants contact-center modernization to align to that control plane.
Teams Phone is strategic and buyer wants packaged contact-center routing/workflow with Microsoft-native operations.

classes.name: Standalone midmarket CCaaS
classes.job: Full omnichannel contact center for mid-size operations without a UC tie.
classes.definition: Full omnichannel contact center for mid-size operations without a UC tie.

bestWhen.statement: Fast-moving sales/support teams need voice, SMS/WhatsApp, CRM/helpdesk integration, analytics and expanding AI with low admin burden.
Bright Pattern is compelling when the buyer wants omnichannel, native WFM, native QM and modern AI in a comparatively unified operating model.
Use UJET when the buyer values packaged cloud CCaaS, transparent pricing, current agentic self-service and a comparatively lower operating burden.
